summary: Version history validation is missing in ReplicateEventsV2 request processing. A TODO comment in replication_task.go indicates this gap, allowing potentially malformed replication tasks to proceed without validation, which could cause incorrect state replication.
userImpact: Missing version history validation allows malformed replication tasks to proceed, causing incorrect state replication and harder-to-diagnose failures.
rootCause: Version history fields lack validation in replication_task.go; TODO comment at line 418 indicates implementation was deferred
proposedFix: Implement version history validation in replication_task.go following team-defined validation requirements
keyQuote: Version history fields are not validated, potentially allowing malformed replication tasks to proceed.
